limits.en: Free access exists for students and teachers only (non-commercial, community assets, 5GB storage), not a general free plan

keyLimits.en: Includes Designer, Painter, Sampler, Stager; 20,000+ assets; 100GB storage
Annual commitment billed monthly, per license, 1TB storage, business admin features

cautions.en: Substance 3D Designer is not sold standalone on this page; the only individual purchase path shown is the full Substance 3D Collection bundle (Designer, Painter, Sampler, Stager).
The Collection for Teams price is per license under an annual commitment billed in monthly installments, not a month-to-month rate.

capabilities.en: Node-based, fully procedural and non-destructive 3D material, pattern and image-filter authoring.
Large built-in content library of nodes, filters, patterns and randomizable noises.
Parametric HDR lighting stage creation, with Pantone and OpenColorIO color management support.
Dedicated shader graph for authoring MDL materials, and export to other Substance 3D apps and major 3D formats.

limitations.en: Not sold as a standalone subscription on the official page; commercial use requires buying the full Substance 3D Collection bundle.
Free access is restricted to students/teachers, non-commercial use only, with a small 5GB storage cap.

reason.en: Sibling Adobe app in the same suite, focused on texturing rather than procedural material creation.
Free alternative covering procedural material and texture creation within a full 3D suite.

unknowns: Exact system requirements/OS platform list was not shown on this page (linked out to separate documentation).
Whether a Designer-only single-app subscription exists outside the Collection bundle was not confirmed.
